details: A senior European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker, Olaf Sleijpen, has cautioned that a significant run on stablecoins could disrupt traditional financial markets. This disruption might necessitate the central bank to reconsider its interest rate policy. Sleijpen indicated that stablecoin issuers might be forced to liquidate substantial amounts of reserve assets, such as US Treasury securities, if investors rapidly redeem their tokens. Such an event could spread financial stress beyond the cryptocurrency ecosystem. The global stablecoin market experienced a 48% growth in 2025, surpassing $300 billion, with dollar-backed tokens being predominant.
title: ECB Warns Stablecoin Runs Could Impact Interest Rates

details: On November 19, Wall Street experienced a broad decline, marking its longest losing streak since 2024, with the S&P 500 dropping 2%. This downturn occurred despite a strong market debut for AI lab Anthropic. The market was weighed down by growing concerns over the sustainability of the AI rally and weaker-than-expected U.S. economic reports, including a slight increase in unemployment benefit applications and slowing manufacturing growth in the mid-Atlantic region. Treasury yields eased as investors moved towards safer assets.
title: Wall Street Falls Amid AI Jitters and Weak US Economic Data

details: The South African rand reached a one-year low against the U.S. dollar on Friday, November 20. This weakening was primarily attributed to uncertainty surrounding coalition talks following recent local elections, coupled with pressure from a stronger U.S. dollar and a hawkish split within the central bank's decision to maintain interest rates. The risk-sensitive currency has been impacted by concerns over political stability and persistent inflation.
title: South African Rand Hits One-Year Low Amid Political Uncertainty

details: Coinbase is reportedly planning to launch its own in-house U.S. prediction market contracts by the first half of 2027, according to Bloomberg. This move would allow the major cryptocurrency exchange greater control over listings and potentially increase its share of trading revenue. Currently, Coinbase offers event contracts through a partnership with Kalshi, which operates the markets. The expansion into proprietary prediction markets signals Coinbase's continued diversification and institutional interest in the crypto ecosystem.
title: Coinbase Plans In-House US Prediction Markets
